title: OpenSetDecisionConfig
description: Configuration schema for inference-time open-set ReID decision rule and threshold calibration.

parameters.description: Hyperparameters for the chosen rule (e.g. lambda for gap, k for znorm/snorm/csls).

lambda.description: Second-best penalty factor for gap rule.

k.description: Number of top cohort cosine neighbors.

cohort_file.description: Relative path to external cohort embeddings .npy file (e.g. val_cohort.npy, release asset, never committed to git).

score_scale.description: Score scale corresponding to the decision rule output.

threshold.description: Calibrated decision threshold operating on the specified score_scale.

calibration.description: Calibration metadata and operating point definitions.

target_tar.description: Target True Accept Rate at which threshold was set (e.g. 0.80).

achieved_far.description: False Alarm Rate measured at the target TAR threshold.

cohort_identities_count.description: Number of held-out cohort identities used (e.g. 50).
